previews.heading: Model Previews
previews.subtitle: Control background preview generation for the whole instance.
previews.infoScope: This only affects the small 3D thumbnail shown on model cards (Models, Collections) — never the full model viewer. It also only applies to files with no thumbnail yet: an embedded thumbnail from a sliced .3mf file, or one already generated before, is always reused automatically regardless of this setting. This choice only decides what happens for the rest — typically .stl/.obj files, or a .3mf with no embedded thumbnail:
previews.infoAutomatic: Automatic — a visitor's browser renders and saves the missing thumbnail as soon as its card scrolls into view.
previews.infoOnDemand: On demand — a card shows a "Generate preview" button instead; nothing renders until someone clicks it.
previews.infoDisabled: Disabled — cards always show a placeholder; a thumbnail is never rendered.
previews.automaticDesc: Load missing previews only as cards enter view, then save them for future visits.
previews.onDemandDesc: Show saved previews immediately and generate missing ones only when requested.
previews.disabledDesc: Never generate card previews. Interactive viewing remains available by opening a model.

triggers.heading: Triggers
triggers.deleteAllTitle: Delete all models for a user
triggers.deleteAllDesc: Permanently deletes every model a user created, uploaded, or imported — files included. Their categories and collections are left in place, just empty.
triggers.deleteFailed: Failed to delete this user's models.
triggers.confirmTitle: Delete all models for this user?
triggers.confirmWarning: This permanently deletes all {{count}} model(s) belonging to {{email}}, including their files. This cannot be undone.
triggers.linkAuthorsDesc: Some imported models show their author only as a name, without the author's profile, avatar or link, because the import couldn't fetch the author at the time. This links each of them to their author: to an author already in Thingport with exactly that name from the same site, or else by looking the author up on the site the model came from. Only details are fetched, never files. It runs for the whole instance, across every user's models, in the background — MakerWorld lookups are spaced out to avoid its CAPTCHA, so they can take a few minutes.
triggers.linkAuthorsLinkable: {{count}} model(s) can be linked right away.
triggers.linkAuthorsLookup: {{count}} model(s) need their author looked up.

triggers.linkAuthorsNotFound: The author couldn't be found for {{count}} creator(s) — the model may have been removed from its site, or the site couldn't be reached.

triggers.refetchDesc: Replaces the description of every model a user imported from MakerWorld, Printables or Thingiverse with the current one from that site, with its formatting and images. Use it to bring models imported before formatted descriptions were supported up to date. Changes the user made to those descriptions are lost. Models whose source is gone keep their description. It runs in the background — MakerWorld requests are spaced out to avoid its CAPTCHA, so a large library can take a while.

simplify.heading: Simplify models before preview
simplify.subtitle: Make lighter 3D previews of very detailed models.
simplify.infoWhat: When a model has more than 1 million triangles, its 3D preview is reduced to about 1 million. The shape stays the same to within 1% of the model's size, so the preview looks the same on screen.
simplify.infoFiles: Only the preview is simplified. Model files, downloads and anything sent to a slicer are never changed.
simplify.infoBenefit: Heavy previews download faster and rotate smoothly on phones, tablets and older computers.
simplify.infoCost: Making the preview of a heavy model takes a few seconds longer on the server. Models under 1 million triangles are not affected.
simplify.infoChange: Changing this setting rebuilds only the previews it affects, the next time each model is opened.
simplify.label: Simplify previews of models over 1 million triangles
simplify.helpOn: On: previews of models over 1 million triangles are simplified.
simplify.helpOff: Off: previews always show a model's full detail.

From 2D art to sculptures, download premium model files and add a touch of beauty and creativity to your space with these unique designs.

602.metaDescription: Construct stunning and realistic 3D printed buildings, castles, and other architectural wonders for your miniature landscapes.

603.name: Creatures
603.metaDescription: Unleash your imagination with our collection of fantastical 3D printed creatures, from mythical monsters to mischievous fairies.

604.name: People
604.metaDescription: Create diverse and realistic 3D printed characters for your tabletop games, role-playing adventures, and dioramas.

605.name: Other Miniatures
605.metaDescription: Discover a vast array of unique and personalized 3D printed miniatures to enhance your gaming experiences and collections.

700.name: Tools
700.metaDescription: There's never enough tools to have, or a way to organize those tools in an efficient manner. But this section is the perfect location to find the files you need to print a specific jig or an organizer for your latest gadget.

701.name: Organizers
701.metaDescription: Keep your workspace and belongings tidy with our functional and customizable 3D printed organizers, trays, and containers.

702.name: Measure Tools
702.metaDescription: Ensure precise measurements with our accurate and versatile 3D printed measuring tools, rulers, and calipers.

703.name: Hand Tools
703.metaDescription: Enhance your toolbox with our durable and customizable 3D printed hand tools, wrenches, and screwdrivers.

704.name: Machine Tools
704.metaDescription: Upgrade your workshop with our precision-crafted 3D printed machine tools, jigs, and fixtures.

705.name: Gadgets
705.metaDescription: Uncover a world of possibilities with our collection of unique and practical 3D printed gadgets, from phone holders to desk organizers.

706.name: Other Tools
706.metaDescription: Discover a vast array of specialized and niche 3D printed tools to meet your specific needs and interests.

707.name: Medical Tools
707.metaDescription: Experience the future of medicine with our innovative 3D printed medical tools, surgical guides, and implants.

800.name: Toys & Games
800.metaDescription: This section is dedicated to printable fun! You will find various board games, toys, puzzles and games which are all ready to be printed and enjoyed after a quick print.

801.name: Characters
801.metaDescription: Create your own personalized 3D printed characters, action figures, and dolls for imaginative play and storytelling.

802.name: Board Games
802.metaDescription: Elevate your game nights with our unique and customizable 3D printed board games, chess sets, and game pieces.

803.name: Outdoor Toys
803.metaDescription: Encourage active play and outdoor adventures with our durable and engaging 3D printed outdoor toys, frisbees, and sports equipment.

804.name: Puzzles
804.metaDescription: Challenge your mind and test your problem-solving skills with our intricate and captivating 3D printed puzzles.

805.name: Other Toys & Games
805.metaDescription: Discover a world of endless possibilities for play, learning, and creativity with our diverse collection of 3D printed toys and games.

806.name: Construction Sets
806.metaDescription: Build and create incredible structures with our versatile and educational 3D printed construction sets, from classic building blocks to STEM-inspired designs.

900.name: 3D Printer
900.metaDescription: Whether you're looking to enhance your 3D printing experience with accessories or need to replace a printer part with a printed one, we have you covered. You can download and print models from a wide selection available just a click away.

901.name: 3D Printer Accessories
901.metaDescription: Elevate your 3D printing experience with our curated selection of premium accessories. Discover a wide range of essential tools and components designed to optimize print quality, enhance performance, and expand the capabilities of your 3D printer.

902.name: 3D Printer Parts
902.metaDescription: Transform your 3D printer into a powerhouse of precision and performance with our extensive range of high-quality 3D printer parts and upgrades. Whether you're seeking to enhance print accuracy, increase printing speed, or expand your printer's functionality, our carefully curated selection of replacement parts and innovative upgrades caters to every need.

903.name: Test Models
903.metaDescription: Ensure flawless prints and optimal performance with our collection of essential 3D printer test models. These meticulously designed models provide a comprehensive platform for evaluating printer settings, diagnosing potential issues, and validating print quality.

1000.name: Props & Cosplays
1000.metaDescription: Even if it's not Halloween, there's always time for printing a cool mask, helmet or other cosplay-related prints. Don't wait until it's too late, and start printing your awesome new outfit!

1001.name: Masks & Helmets
1001.metaDescription: Elevate your cosplay with our detailed and realistic 3D printed masks, helmets, and other facial accessories.

1002.name: Cosplay Weapons
1002.metaDescription: Dive into the amazing cosplay world with our 3D printed props! We've got finely designed swords and shields, ideal for you to embody your favorite characters. Unleash their power and enjoy immersive role-playing!

1003.name: Costumes
1003.metaDescription: Create stunning and authentic 3D printed costumes, from superhero suits to fantasy armor, for your next cosplay event or Halloween.

1004.name: Other Props & Cosplays
1004.metaDescription: Enhance your cosplay with our diverse collection of 3D printed props, accessories, and gadgets to complete your transformation.

2000.name: Generative 3D Model
2000.metaDescription: Here you can find creative models built using 3D model generators. They are beautifully crafted and may provide inspiration on how to utilize these generators.

2001.name: Hueforge & Lithophane
2001.metaDescription: Transform your favorite images into stunning 3D art pieces with Hueforge and create mesmerizing lithophanes that glow with light.

2002.name: Make My Sign
2002.metaDescription: Create personalized and eye-catching signs using our user-friendly Make My Sign tool, perfect for home décor, businesses, and special occasions.

2003.name: Make My Vase
2003.metaDescription: Design and customize unique and beautiful vases with our intuitive Make My Vase tool, from simple shapes to intricate patterns, solid or hollow.

2004.name: Pixel Puzzle Maker
2004.metaDescription: Convert your cherished images into captivating pixel art puzzles using our Pixel Puzzle Maker tool, perfect for fun challenges and creative displays.

2005.name: Relief Sculpture Maker
2005.metaDescription: Elevate your artwork with our 3D to Relief Sculpture tool, seamlessly transforming 3D models or images into stunning bas-relief sculptures.

2006.name: AI Scanner
2006.metaDescription: Recreate 3D assets with remarkable accuracy using our AI Scanner tool, simply capture a continuous video and let the AI do the rest.

2007.name: Image to Keychain
2007.metaDescription: Turns images into keychains, bookmarks and other 2D Art models.

2008.name: Make My Desk Organizer
2008.metaDescription: Design your perfect desk organizer. Customize every detail to fit exactly what you need.

2009.name: PrintMon Maker
2009.metaDescription: Generate adorable creatures from text or images, ready for 3D printing.

2010.name: Statue Maker
2010.metaDescription: Turn Your Portrait into a Lifelike 3D Masterpiece.

2011.name: Christmas Ornament Maker
2011.metaDescription: Create personalized, spinning 2D Christmas ornaments with the Christmas Ornament Maker, perfect for decorations or gifts.

2012.name: Make My Lantern
2012.metaDescription: Generate a hollowed lantern from an image.
